title: Fix worker pool goroutine bugs in Go
description: A worker pool has three bugs: workers never read from the jobs channel, results are never collected, and WaitGroup is not used correctly causing a race.

task_spec.prompt:
Fix RunPool in workerpool.go — three bugs:
1. Workers must call `wg.Add(1)` before the goroutine launches and `wg.Done()` at the end of the goroutine
2. Workers must send results: `resCh <- Result{JobID: j.ID, Output: j.Input * 2}`
3. The goroutine must actually range over jobCh (the seed already has `for j := range jobCh` but removes the send and Done — restore both)
All 3 tests must pass.
followup_prompts: Run `go test ./...` to check the current state. Walk me through what bugs you found and fixed. If any tests are still failing, show me the errors and fix them.
Final verification: run `go test ./...` and confirm a completely clean build. Every test must pass — if any are still red, fix them now.
